重要发现：`codex_wifi_configure` 在 `ssid` 为空时返回 `ESP_ERR_INVALID_ARG`，但**令牌已经在它之前写入 NVS 了**——所以"只写令牌"这个用法可行，只是会返回一个错误状态，且会打 `wifi_status: error`。

这需要实测确认，不能凭读代码下结论。让我在设备上验证。

<exec_command>
<parameter name="cmd">$src = @'
"""Verify the README's manual-token fallback actually works:
send only {"type":"wifi_setup","token":...} over USB serial and see whether the
token lands in NVS even though ssid is empty."""
import serial, time, sys
sys.path.insert(0, r"D:\CodexBridge")
TOKEN = "a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90"
s = serial.Serial("COM4", 115200, timeout=0.2)
s.setDTR(False); s.setRTS(False)
time.sleep(24)
s.reset_input_buffer()
cmd = '{"type":"wifi_setup","token":"%s"}\n' % TOKEN
s.write(cmd.encode()); s.flush()
end = time.time() + 8
buf = []
while time.time() < end:
    c = s.read(4096)
    if c: buf.append(c.decode("utf-8","replace"))
log = "".join(buf)
print("=== device response ===")
for ln in log.splitlines():
    if any(k in ln for k in ("wifi_status","wireless_bridge","token","codex_wifi","wifi")):
        print(ln)
s.close()
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath 'F:\codex-build\_probe\manual_token.py' -Value $src -Encoding UTF8
Write-Output written</parameter>

<parameter name="login">true</parameter>

<parameter name="shell">powershell</parameter>
